Classifying all routine administrative government reports as top secret to prevent public dissemination and disclosure

explanation_english: The National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy sets the operational framework for sharing non-sensitive government data with the public. key_facts: NDSAP promotes open data sharing for public benefit.
